reasons.stylize2_roughen: Roughen Edges' fractal edge comes from After Effects' own noise and random generator; ours is a look-alike
reasons.stylize2_scatter: Scatter moves pixels by After Effects' own random generator; ours scatters by a seeded hash
reasons.stylize2_brush_strokes: Brush Strokes places strokes by After Effects' own random generator; ours is a look-alike
reasons.stylize2_burn_film: CC Burn Film burns along After Effects' own noise; ours is a look-alike
reasons.stylize2_ccglass: CC Glass has no renderer yet (bump-mapped lighting not reproduced); reference kept for that work
reasons.stylize2_ccplastic: CC Plastic has no renderer yet (bump-mapped lighting not reproduced); reference kept for that work
reasons.stylize2_ccplastic_point: CC Plastic has no renderer yet (bump-mapped lighting not reproduced); reference kept for that work
reasons.stylize2_cartoon: Cartoonify has no renderer yet; reference kept for that work
reasons.stylize2_smoothie: CC Mr. Smoothie has no renderer yet; reference kept for that work
reasons.stylize2_repetile_cells: CC RepeTile's Random tiling turns and flips tiles by After Effects' own random generator; ours by a seeded hash (the Twist layer beside it matches)
